text: Good breeding consists in concealing how much we think of ourselves and how little we think of the other person.
author: Mark Twain
visual_brief: An architectural cross-section of an ornate neoclassical facade adorned with detailed pediments and moldings facing outward, revealing that behind the thin decorative wall sits only a raw, angled timber truss bracing it from the rear. Rendered in a crisp architectural drafting style with fine dimension lines, section hatching, and callouts.
alt: Architectural drawing of an ornate facade supported by hidden structural scaffolding
